Hɑɑ mɩɩm
Ayn, Sɩɩn, Kaaf.
Yaa woto bal la Wẽnd tʋmsd fo nengẽ la neb nins sẽn reng fo taoorã; Wẽnd sẽn yaa wilb Naabã n yaa Bʋʋd-Mitã.
Yẽ n so sẽn be saasẽ la sẽn be Tengẽ, la Yẽnda la zẽkr Naab n yaa Na-zɩsgo.
Saasã rat n pãrsã yĩngrã, tɩ malεgsã yɩlgd b Soabã ne A pẽkã, la b kot yaafa n kõt neb nins sẽn be Tẽngã zugu, yaa sɩda, ad yaa Wẽnd la Yaafg Naab n yaa Yolsg Naaba.
La neb nins sẽn gãd lall-n-taas zẽng tɩ pa yɩ ne Yẽ wã, Wẽnd yaa gũusd b zugu, la fo pa yɩ n yaa b sẽn boabl a soaba ne b tʋʋmɑ gũusg ye.

La yaa woto bal la Tõnd tʋms fo nengẽ Alkʋrãan sẽn yaa laarabiindu, bʋɩl yĩng tɩ f na bugs tẽmsã Ma (Maka) la neb nins sẽn gũbg-a wã. La f bugs tɩ sik kae ne tigsgã raar ye, sull n be arzãna pʋgẽ, tɩ sull me be Bugmẽ wã.
La Wẽnd sã n da tʋllẽ A na maanẽ-b zãma a yembre, lɑ A kẽesda A sẽn rat a soab A yolsgã pʋgẽ. La wẽgdbã, bãmb pa tar lalld buudu, b pa tar sõngd me.
Bɩ b gãda lall-n-taas zẽms tɩ pa tũ ne Yẽ. Ad Wẽnde, Yẽ la lallda, la Yẽ n vʋʋgd kũ-rãmba, la Yẽ n yaa Tõod bũmb fãa zugu.
La yãmb sẽn yõs taab a pʋgẽ sẽn yaa bũmb ning fãa, a bʋʋdã bee ne Wẽnde, yãmb Wẽnd-kãng la mam Soabã, Yẽ la mam bobl m mengã, m lebsa m mengã Yẽ nengẽ.
Saas la Tẽng yẽbgdã, A maana pagb sẽn yi yãmb mensẽ wã n kõ yãmba. Rũmsã me yaa yãang la raoogo, A wʋsgdɑ yãmb sẽn tũ ne rẽ. Bũmb pa be n wõnd-A ye, la Yẽnda la Wʋmd n yaa Neta.
A soo saas la Tẽng kʋɩlen-biisi, A yεdgda rɩtlã ne A sẽn rat a soaba, la A kẽgsd ne A sẽn rat a soaba, ad A yaa Mit ne bũmbã fãa gilli.

۞A tuka sor dĩinã pʋg n kõ yãmba, rẽ la A sẽn sagl a Nuuh ne bũmb ningã, rẽ me la bũmb ning Tõnd sẽn tʋms fo nengẽ wã, rẽ me la Tõnd sẽn sagl ne a ɭbraahɩɩm, lɑ a Musɑ la ʿIisa wã, tɩ y yãnas ne dĩinã, la y ra bao n na n wels taab a pʋgẽ ye. Paka logem-n-taarã rãmba, bũmb ning yãmb sẽn boond-b n tʋgdẽ wã, Wẽnd tũusda A sẽn rat soab n pẽneg A Menga, la A kãndgd ned ning sẽn lebsd a meng A nengẽ.

La b pa yõs taaba, rẽnda bãngrã sẽn wa b nengẽ poorẽ, kedgr bãmb ne taab sʋka, la sã n pa gomd sẽn reng taoor n yi fo Soabã nengẽ t'A nɑ n yɑoolɑ nɑngã n tʋg wakat sẽn tar raare, b naan n bʋẽ bãmb ne taab sʋka. Lɑ sɩdã, b sẽn kõ gafã neb nins tɩ yaa faad ne bãmbã, bãmb reng-tɑoor rãmbã loogr poorẽ, b bee sik pʋgẽ ne-a (Alkʋrãanã), n maand sãmbse.

Rẽ yĩng bɩ f boole (n tʋg sɩda, lɩɩmaoong la zems taaba), la f tẽeg tɩrg wala b sẽn sagl foomã. Ra pʋg b yõyã yamleood ye. Yeele: "M kõo sɩd ne bũmb ning fãa Wẽnd sẽn sikã sẽn yaa gafã. B sagla maam tɩ m tẽeg tɩrg yãmb sʋka; Wẽnd la tõnd Soab la yãmb Soaba. Tõnd tʋʋm bee ne tõndo, yãmb me tʋʋm bee ne yãmba, tak-n-taar pa be tõnd ne yãmb sʋk ye, Wẽnd n tigimd tõnd ne taaba, la lebεng zĩig yaa Yẽ nengẽ".
Neb nins sẽn maan-b tak-n-taar Wẽnd yellã pʋgẽ wã, nebã sẽn sak-A poorẽ, bãmb daliilã pa tar võor b Soabã nengẽ ye. Gẽeg n be b zugu, naon-kεgeng me leb n be b zugu.
Wẽnd la Soab ning sẽn sika gafã ne sɩd la tẽeg-tɩrga. Lɑ bõe n wilgd foo tɩ dũni yikr pɑ pẽ?
Neb nins sẽn pa kõt sɩdã yãgda ne-a, la neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã yaeesd-a lame la b mi t'a yaa sɩda. Neb nins sẽn wẽed no-koεεmã dũni yikrã zugã, sɩd la hakɩɩka b bee meneng sẽn zãag pʋgẽ.
Wẽnd yaa bʋg-bʋg (lom-lom) Soɑb ne A yembsã, n rɩlgd A sẽn rat a soaba, la Yẽnda la pãng Naaba n yaa Winda.
Ned ning sẽn wa n rat laahr koodo D paasd-a-la a koodẽ wã, la ned ning sẽn wa n rata dunĩ koodo, D kõt-a-la a pʋgẽ, la a pa tar baa pʋɩɩr laahrã ye.
Bɩ bãmb tara lagem-n-taas tɩ b tuk sor sẽn yaa dĩin n kõ bãmbɑ, Wẽnd sẽn pa kõ sor ne dĩĩn ningɑ. Sã n pa gom wεldgã yĩnga, b naan n bʋ bãmb ne taab sʋka, la ad wẽgdbã tara naong sẽn zabde.

Fo nee wẽgdbã tɩ b yaeesd bũmb ning b sẽn tʋmã rolbo, t'a yaool n na n lʋɩɩ b zugu. Lɑ neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩd la b tʋm sõmã wã, b bee arzãn pʋtẽ wã, b tara bũmb ning fãa b sẽn tʋll b Soabã nengẽ, woto la pʋɩ-bedrã.

Rẽ la bũmb ning Wẽnd sẽn noogd ne A yembs nins sẽn kõ sɩdã la b tʋm sõmã wã sũyã, yeele: "m pa sokd yãmb keoor a zug ye, rẽnda nonglem rogmã yĩnga". Ned ning sẽn tʋma yel-sõmde, D paasd-a-la sõmblem a pʋgẽ, ad Wẽnd yaa yaafg Naaba n yaa bark Pʋʋsda.
Bɩ b yetame: "a pasga zĩri-beed n rogl Wẽnde". La Wẽnd sã n tʋlla, A pagda fo sũurã. La Wẽnd yẽesda zĩri-beedã la A sɩdg sɩdã ne A goamã, ad A yaa Mit ne bũmb ning sẽn be yãadẽ wã,
la Yẽ la Soab ning sẽn reegd tuubgã A yembsã nengẽ, la A yaafd n basd yel-wẽna, la A mi bũmb ning yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
La A reegd neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩd la b tʋm sõma wã tʋʋma; la kɩfr-rãmbã, naong kεgeng be ne-ba,
۞Lɑ Wẽnd sã n dɑ yεdg A rɩtlã ne A yembsã b na kedg Tẽngã zugu, la ad A sikd-a lame ne alkadr ning A sẽn rate, ad A yaa kiba-Mit ne A yembsã, n leb n yaa Net ne-ba.
Yẽ la Soab ning sẽn sikd sa-koomã b sẽn wãag b tẽeb poorẽ la A sãeegd A yolsgã. Yẽnda la Lalld n yɑɑ pẽgr Naaba.
La sẽn be A yel-soalmã pʋgẽ, yaa saasã la Tẽngã naanego, la bũmb ning A sẽn sãeeg b yiibã pʋgẽ sẽn yaa bõn-kẽndse, la Yẽnda yaa tõogd ne b tiging t'A sã n rata.
La yell buud sẽn paam yãmb fãa, yaa yãmb nusã sẽn tʋme, la A (Wẽnd) yaafdame n basd wʋsgo.
La yãmb pa yɩ n yaa põsdb Tẽngã zug ye. Yãmb pa tar bɑɑ lalld zẽng sẽn pa yɩ ne Wẽnde, y leb n pa tar sõngd me ye.
La sẽn leb n be A yel-soalmã pʋga, yaa bõn-zoetsã (koglsã) mogrã zug wala tãmsã.
A sã n tʋlla A yõkda sobgã tɩ b kell n yãsẽ bal a zugu, sɩd la hakɩɩka ad yel-soalem be rẽ pʋgẽ wã ne sugr soab fãa sẽn yaa bark pʋʋsda.
Maa A halk-b ne bũmb ning b sẽn tʋmã, la A yaafdame n basd wʋsgo.
La neb nins sẽn maan tak-n-taar Tõnd yel-soalmã pʋgẽ wã miime tɩ b pa tar põsg zĩig ye.
La b sẽn kõ yãmb bũmb ning fãa, yaa dũnĩ vɩɩm wʋm-noogo, la bũmb ning sẽn be Wẽnd nengẽ wã n yɩɩd sõma la kellg ne neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã la b bobend b mens ne b Soabã.
La neb nins sẽn zãagd zũunuub bεdã, la yel-beedã tʋʋmã, tɩ b sũyã sã n wa yik bɩ b basdẽ tɩ loogã.
La neb nins sẽn sak b Soabã sagellã la b yãnesd Pʋʋsgã, tɩ b yellã yaa saawar bãmb ne taab sʋkã, tɩ bũmb ning Tõnd sẽn kõ-ba pʋgẽ b yãkd n nafdẽ wã.
La neb nins tɩ wẽgb sã n ta-b la b sẽn wind wẽgdã n tõoge.
La wẽng rolb yaa wẽngã bilg-n-taare; la sẽn yaafa la a manege, a keoorã bee ne Wẽnde, ad A pa nong wẽgdbã ye.
La ned ning sẽn wila, b sẽn wẽg-a poorẽ, bãmbã sor pa be b zug ye.
Ad sor sẽn be wã yaa neb nins sẽn wẽgd nebã, la b maand n kedgd Tẽngã zug tɩ pa tũ ne sɩdã, bãmbã tara naon-zabdga.
La ned ning sẽn maana sugr la a bas tɩ looge, ad woto la sẽb-sʋk yεla.
La ned ning Wẽnd sẽn menemse, a kõn n paam lall-n-taag A poorẽ ye. La fo na n yãa wẽgdbã tɩ b sã n wa yã naongã, b yetame: "rẽ yĩnga tõnd tõe n le leba (dũni) bɩ?"

Fo yãt-b lɑme tɩ b bɑll-b Bugmã zug tɩ b yɑɑ vɑlemse yɑɑlg keelem, n lɩkd n getẽ, tɩ sẽn kõ-b sɩdã yeele: "ɑd bõn rãmb yɑɑ sẽn bõn b mens lɑ b zɑgs rãmb dũni-yikrã rɑɑre, yɑɑ sɩdɑ ɑd wẽgdbã bee naong duumdg pʋgẽ.
Lɑ b pɑ tɑr lɑlld buud sẽn nɑ fãɑg-b n yi Wẽnd naongã ye, lɑ Wẽnd sẽn menems ɑ soɑbɑ, ɑ pɑ tɑr sor buud sẽn nɑ kãndg ye.
Sɑk-y y Soɑbã yĩngɑ tɑoor tɩ rɑɑr nɑ n pɑ wɑ tɩ Wẽnd pa na n viig-a ye. Yãmb pɑ tɑr rellg zĩig bɑɑ fʋɩ, y leb n pɑ tɑr kɩɩsg buudu n kɩɩs y zũunuubã ye.

Lɑ b sã n raeege, ɑd Tõnd pɑ tʋms foom tɩ f yɑɑ gũusd b zug ye, pɑ be ne foom rẽndɑ tɑɑsgo. Lɑ Tõnd sã n leems ninsɑɑl yolsgo sẽn yi Tõnd nengẽ lɑ ɑ sẽn kɩdemd ne-ɑ, lɑ wẽng sã n pɑɑm-bɑ b nus sẽn tʋm tɩ reng tɑoore sɑbɑbo, lɑ ninsɑɑl sẽn yɑɑ sõm-zɩtɑ.
Wẽnd n so saas la Tẽng naam, A naanda A sẽn tʋlle, A kõta A sẽn tʋll a soab kom-pugli la A kõt A sẽn tʋll a soaba kom-ribli.
Maa A kõ-b kom-ribli la kom-pugli, la A maan A sẽn tʋll a soab t'a yaa kiri, Ad A yaa Mit n yaa Tõogda.
۞Yĩng soab pa yɩ tɩ Wẽnd na n gom ne-a rẽndame tɩ tũ ne Wahɩ maa lill poorẽ, maa b tool tẽn-tʋʋm (malεka) t'a wa ne wahɩ sẽn tũ ne A sor kũuni, A sẽn rate. Ad A yaa sek-m-meng Soab n yaa Bʋʋd-Mita.

Yaa woto la Tõnd tʋms Vɩɩm (Alkʋrãanã) sẽn yi Tõnd nengẽ, fo rag n ka mi yaa bõe la Gafã, pa Lɩɩmaoong me, La ad Tõnd maan-a lame t'a yaa vẽenem, tɩ D kãndgd ne-a Tõnd sẽn tʋll a soaba D yembsẽ wã, La sɩd la hakɩɩka, fo kãndgdame n tʋgd sor sẽn yɑɑ tɩrga.
Sor sẽn yaa Wẽnd sore, Soab ning sẽn so sẽn be saasẽ la sẽn be Tẽngẽ wã sore. Yaa woto bal tɩ bũmb fãa lεbeng zĩig yaa Wẽnd nengẽ.
